We want Tesseract https://mirage.app/tesseract to render 3D that is indistinguishable from footage. You'll be the founding engineer for photoreal 3D in Tesseract, our Rust-based, cross-platform graphics and media rendering engine.

Tesseract already renders video, motion graphics, effects and compositing in a color- managed pipeline. You'll build 3D to the same standard: a fast interactive preview for editing, and a physically based final render, path-traced or hybrid ray-traced, that produces film-quality frames for export. Both run from one scene, material and lighting model, so what people see while they edit is what they export.

Scenes are authored by people and by AI agents, so render cost, failure modes and APIs matter as much as image quality. This is a foundational role: you'll make the core architectural decisions and help build the team around them.

What you'll do

 - Define the architecture for photoreal 3D: how ray tracing, rasterization and denoising divide the work, and how that maps onto Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D and WebGPU.

 - Build light transport: global illumination, reflections and refraction, soft shadows from area lights, and volumetrics such as haze, fog and light shafts.

 - Build a physically based model for materials, lights and cameras: energy-conserving materials (metal, glass, clearcoat, sheen, translucency), lights in real-world units, and a camera with exposure, depth of field and motion blur.

 - Own image quality: sampling, antialiasing, accumulation, denoising and firefly suppression, with frames that stay stable and deterministic across a video export.

 - Scale scenes to production complexity with acceleration structures, instancing, culling and memory management, for millions of triangles and tens of thousands of objects.

 - Integrate 3D into Tesseract's video, motion graphics and compositing pipeline, including ACES color management and render passes such as depth, normals, motion vectors and light groups.

 - Make render cost predictable and rendering robust: performance budgets, profiling, and headless batch rendering on local and cloud GPUs.

 - Design 3D APIs that work for people and AI agents alike: a clear scene representation, actionable validation errors, fast previews and render cost known before the render.

 - Work with engine, product and AI teams, and help hire and grow the 3D rendering team.

What makes you a great fit

 - Deep experience building physically based renderers in production: film or offline renderers, path tracers, or game engines with ray-traced or hybrid lighting.

 - Strong command of light transport: the rendering equation, Monte Carlo integration, importance sampling, material models and denoising.

 - Hands-on GPU ray tracing: building and traversing acceleration structures (BVHs), hardware ray-tracing APIs such as Metal ray tracing, Vulkan ray tracing or DXR, and compute-based fallbacks.

 - A solid understanding of modern rasterization pipelines, and of how hybrid renderers combine rasterization with ray tracing.

 - Hands-on experience with Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU, including compute shaders, GPU profiling and GPU debugging.

 - Proficiency in Rust or C++, with strong reasoning about memory, concurrency and performance.

 - Strong foundations in the mathematics of graphics: linear algebra, geometry, probability and sampling.

 - An eye for realism: you can look at a frame, say why it doesn't read as real, and fix the cause.

 - Experience owning complex technical projects and making architectural decisions in ambiguous problem spaces.

Even better if…

 - You've worked on the internals of a production renderer or engine such as Cycles, Arnold, RenderMan, V-Ray, Karma, Unreal Engine (Lumen or its path tracer) or Unity HDRP.

 - You've built or integrated ML denoisers, or worked on neural rendering.

 - You've worked with color management (ACES, OpenColorIO), HDR output or film-look pipelines.

 - You've built on cross-platform graphics abstractions such as wgpu, including extending them where they lack features such as ray tracing.

 - You've optimized rendering for Apple silicon or mobile GPUs.

 - You have experience with Rust, video compositing, or integrating 2D and 3D rendering in creative tools.

 JPMorganChase is hiring top talent to join the growing Commercial \& Investment Bank Technology organization within Digital \& Platform Services / Data Analytics, building production AI agents on NEO that leverage the firm's scale, data, and full\-service advantage to deliver measurable impact across the Commercial \& Investment Bank and Payments. **Job Responsibilities**
* Design and ship production agents on NEO across the federated portfolio, owning them from prototype through production.

* Own organizational context management — assembling entitlement\-, lineage\-, and tenant\-aware context so each agent reasons over only what it's allowed to see.
* Compose multi\-agent workflows using A2A, and integrate tools and data through MCP servers (Bitbucket, Confluence, Databricks, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Splunk).
* Build and run evals: task\-level and end\-to\-end agent evaluations, regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge, and quality/safety gating before release.
* Deploy and operate solutions on public cloud (AWS and, or Azure) with strong SDLC, security, resiliency, and observability practices.
* Partner with product and business partners across CIB and Payments to turn use cases into shipped, supported agents.
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience with working on AI/ML solutions.
* Hands\-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Advanced in one or more programming language(s) \- Strong programming skills in Python, with deep knowledge of data structures, algorithms, machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, and statistics.
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered or agentic applications in production, including tracing, evaluations, and guardrails.
* Deep proficiency with Kubernetes and Amazon EKS, micro\-VM isolation (e.g., Firecracker, Kata Containers, gVisor), and sidecar architectures, with proven experience designing defense in depth across the stack: network and mTLS, workload identity, fine\-grained authorization, runtime isolation for untrusted or adversarial workloads, and application\-level guardrails
* Practical RAG experience — retrieval quality, embeddings, and vector stores; Expert knowledge of at least one of: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes. Knowledge of data management and data model design; real\-time processing using both SQL (e.g., Postgres) and NoSQL stores (e.g., OpenSearch, Redis).
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* In\-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems


**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience with agent frameworks or runtimes, A2A, or MCP. Agent memory design (memory nodes, episodic/semantic memory) and organizational context management.
* Knowledge graphs and graph databases used for retrieval. Graph RAG a strong plus.
* Understanding of LLM fine\-tuning and small language model inference.
* Ability to develop full\-stack products using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., Next.js, Svelte) for agent UIs (AG\-UI , NEO UI SDK).
* Experience working in the financial or payments domain at a large institution (Investment Banking, Markets, Securities Services, or adjacent).
* Knowledge of high\-performance languages such as Go or Rust
